# Plugin command family catalog

Plugins declare namespaced CLI commands under the host `sforum` command registry. The host invokes the exact runtime via `InvokeCommand` after trust, permission, and safe-mode checks.

Source of truth: Go catalogs under `apps/api` (`app/Support/Events`, `Capabilities`, `ExtensionManifest`, `Jobs`, and provider slot constants). Regenerate with:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate
```

Or verify CI drift:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate --check
```

## Callable transport boundary

Plugin commands are CLI/host-invoked against the exact runtime. There is no plugin-to-host RPC for running a peer plugin command.

Callable transport exists (see wire RPCs).

## Limits

- **timeoutMs**: 1..5000
- **permission**: when set, must also appear in package `permissions` or `permissionDefinitions`
- **recoverySafe**: only recovery-safe commands remain available in safe mode

## Manifest declaration fields

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `id` / `contractVersion` | Versioned command identity; `contractVersion` is `id@positiveVersion` |
| `handler` | Required executable handler id |
| `permission` | Optional operator permission gate |
| `inputSchema` / `resultSchema` | Versioned schema refs |
| `description` | CLI help text |
| `recoverySafe` | Safe-mode eligibility |
| `timeoutMs` | Host-enforced deadline (1..max) |

## Wire RPCs

| Direction | RPC | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host → plugin | `InvokeCommand` | CLI/host execution against exact artifact |
| Plugin → host | — | **None.** Plugins cannot invoke peer plugin commands over Host API. |

SDK: `pluginv2.CommandRegistry` validates executable declarations and dispatches `InvokeCommand`.
